From the text, form the line through A(0,0), B(3,1): slope 1/3, equation y=x/3. Check its intersections with the four rectangle sides; it meets y=5 at x=15, giving the point (15,5), and does not otherwise lie on a side segment. Form the line through C(0,10), D(2,9): slope -1/2, equation y=10-x/2. Check the rectangle sides; at x=15 and x=16 it has y-values below 3, and when y is 3 to 5 its x-values are 10 to 14, outside the rectangle. Therefore only one rectangle point lies on at least one line.
